value.name: Asha reviews corrected filing stack
value.description: Asha holds the marked page, then slides the corrected stack to the table's edge and aligns it carefully, signaling her focus on the filing's proper handling.
evidence: The marked page stayed under Asha's palm a long minute before she lifted her hand and slid the corrected stack to the edge of the table, lining the spines up against the grain of the wood

value.name: Asha worries about filing chain of custody
value.description: Asha considers how the Tuesday filing will move into Monday's record and whose name will be attached to it, revealing her concern about responsibility and consequences.
evidence: what remained was the narrower one of how that page would travel from this kitchen into Monday's record, and through whose name
what it would cost him, and her, to put either of their names beside that X in front of Whitfield on Monday morning

value.name: Rosa clears the mugs
value.description: Rosa silently takes the empty mugs to the sink, leaving Asha alone with the paperwork and her phone.
evidence: Rosa rose without a word and carried the empty mugs to the sink, leaving Asha alone with the stack and with the soft buzz of her phone face-down beside it

value.name: Calendar reminder alerts Asha
value.description: Asha's phone buzzes with a second alert for the seven a.m. partners' meeting, underscoring the urgency of her obligations.
evidence: the soft buzz of her phone face-down beside it, where a calendar reminder for the seven a.m. partners' meeting had just lit the screen for the second time

value.name: Asha checks the reminder without opening message
value.description: Asha turns over her phone and reads the sender line but delays opening the message, showing hesitation.
evidence: She turned the phone over, read the sender line, and did not yet open it

value.name: Asha reflects on Devin's signature
value.description: Asha thinks about Devin, who signed Tuesday's page because she had been unreachable for three days, and weighs the cost to both of them.
evidence: she was thinking, instead, about Devin—the second-year who had signed Tuesday's page in good faith because she had not answered her phone for three days

value.name: Rosa asks about calling Devin
value.description: Rosa breaks the silence by asking Asha when she will call Devin, pushing the issue into the open.
evidence: "So," she said, quiet, "when do you call Devin?"

value.name: Asha opens a new message
value.description: After hesitating, Asha begins composing or opening a new message on her phone in response to Rosa's question.
evidence: Asha didn't answer right away; she turned the phone upright in her hand, thumbed past the calendar reminder without dismissing it, and opened a new me
